bloodlines.arcana: Whenever you cast a spell of the charm subschool, increase its save DC by 2.

powers.name: Corrupting Touch
powers.summary: Touch a creature to make it shaken for half your sorcerer level in rounds; the effect has the evil descriptor. Uses per day equal 3 + Charisma modifier.

powers.name: Infernal Resistances
powers.summary: Gain fire resistance 5 and a +2 bonus on saving throws against poison, increasing to fire resistance 10 and +4 against poison at 9th level.

powers.name: Hellfire
powers.summary: Create a 10-foot-radius burst within 60 feet for 1d6 fire damage per sorcerer level, Reflex half; good creatures that fail are also shaken for one round per sorcerer level. Uses increase at 17th and 20th levels.

powers.name: On Dark Wings
powers.summary: Grow batlike wings as a standard action for a 60-foot fly speed with average maneuverability, dismissing them as a free action.

powers.name: Power of the Pit
powers.summary: Gain immunity to fire and poison, acid and cold resistance 10, and the ability to see perfectly in darkness within 60 feet.

bloodlines.arcana: Corporeal undead that were once humanoids are treated as humanoids for determining which of your spells affect them, allowing your mind-affecting spells to affect such undead.

powers.name: Grave Touch
powers.summary: Touch a living creature to make it shaken for half your sorcerer level in rounds; a second touch can frighten an already shaken creature with fewer Hit Dice than your sorcerer level for 1 round. Uses per day equal 3 + Charisma modifier.

powers.name: Death's Gift
powers.summary: Gain cold resistance 5 and DR 5/- against nonlethal damage, increasing to cold resistance 10 and DR 10/- against nonlethal damage at 9th level.

powers.name: Grasp of the Dead
powers.summary: Skeletal arms erupt in a 20-foot-radius burst within 60 feet, dealing 1d6 slashing damage per sorcerer level, Reflex half; creatures that fail cannot move for 1 round. Uses increase at 17th and 20th levels.

powers.name: Incorporeal Form
powers.summary: Once per day become incorporeal for one round per sorcerer level, gaining the usual protection from corporeal attacks while your damaging spells deal half damage to corporeal creatures.

powers.name: One of Us
powers.summary: Gain immunity to cold, nonlethal damage, paralysis, and sleep; DR 5/-; unintelligent undead ignore you until attacked; and +4 morale on saves against undead spells and spell-like abilities.
